newsitem.title: USA: Sealy says mulling special $100 mln dividend.
newsitem.headline: Sealy says mulling special $100 mln dividend.

text.p: Closely held mattress maker Sealy Corp said Friday it was considering paying a special dividend of up to $100 million to its investors.
The dividend is subject to board approval and approval by holders of the company's $200 million in subordinated notes. Approval is also contingent on a new credit facility, a company spokesman said.
Sealy said it was seeking a "slightly larger facility" than the $125 million revolving credit facility it has in place.
As of December 1, Sealy's total debt was $288 million, the spokesman said. The company has no immediate plans for a public offering, he said.
